scope: Bounded primary-source mechanism and model-contract review; no independent reproduction or exhaustive priority certification
citation_handoff: Parent must open or search/find a primary URL itself before reusing a child retrieval reference in its final answer. The short IDs W1/R1 are local bibliography keys, not web citation IDs.

sources.title: HyperNetworks
sources.authors: David Ha, Andrew Dai, Quoc V. Le
sources.support_paraphrase: A smaller network produces another network's weights; training is end-to-end, with experiments on convolutional and recurrent models.
sources.boundary: Establishes weight generation as prior art. Parameter-count savings do not by themselves establish lower inference RAM or faster language-model execution.

sources.title: NeRN: Learning Neural Representations for Neural Networks
sources.authors: Maor Ashkenazi et al.
sources.support_paraphrase: A coordinate-based neural predictor maps positions in a pretrained convolutional network to kernel weights. The work discusses smoothness, reconstruction sensitivity, and knowledge distillation, and evaluates CIFAR and ImageNet models.
sources.boundary: Direct learned-weight-reconstruction precedent; not evidence for LLM runtime or guaranteed preservation from small weight error.

sources.title: Neural Weight Compression for Language Models
sources.authors: Jegwang Ryu, Minkyu Kim, Seungjun Shin, Hee Min Choi, Dokwan Oh, Jaeho Lee
sources.support_paraphrase: Learns a neural weight codec with transforms, entropy-constrained quantization, and downstream-sensitive reconstruction. Its latency analysis reconstructs a full-precision 4096 by 4096 tensor in VRAM and sums synthesis and separately benchmarked entropy decoding; inter-layer recovery fine-tuning is excluded from the tensor encoding timing.
sources.boundary: The paper's tensor timing is not an end-to-end local assistant benchmark. Main text and appendix use different RTX 6000/A6000 names, so avoid precise hardware claims without author clarification. Do not confuse this paper with independently named NWC repositories found by search.

sources.title: PocketLLM: Ultimate Compression of Large Language Models via Meta Networks
sources.authors: Ye Tian, Chengcheng Wang, Jing Han, Yehui Tang, Kai Han
sources.support_paraphrase: An encoder maps LLM weights into discrete latent vectors represented by a compact codebook; a lightweight decoder maps selected code vectors back to weight space. The stored representation includes decoder, codebook, and index.
sources.boundary: A direct precedent to a small learned weight decoder. The title's strong framing and author-reported compression result should not be repeated as an Olympus claim.

sources.title: Motion-Compensated Weight Compression
sources.authors: Ismail Lamaakal
sources.support_paraphrase: Aligns permutation-symmetric blocks across layers, predicts layers sequentially with periodic keyframes, and entropy-codes quantized prediction residuals under a rate-distortion objective. The decoder reverses that sequence and alignment.
sources.boundary: Prediction plus residuals and keyframes is already directly proposed. Its empirical claims are author reports from a preprint, not independently reproduced results.

sources.title: 70% Size, 100% Accuracy: Lossless LLM Compression for Efficient GPU Inference via Dynamic-Length Float (DFloat11)
sources.authors: Tianyi Zhang, Mohsen Hariri, Shaochen Zhong, Vipin Chaudhary, Yang Sui, Xia Hu, Anshumali Shrivastava
sources.support_paraphrase: Uses entropy coding of BFloat16 weight representations with custom online GPU decompression, compact hierarchical lookup tables, and transformer-block-level reconstruction. Its stated throughput comparison concerns offloading uncompressed weights to CPU under memory constraints.
sources.boundary: Exact compression and online block reconstruction are prior art. The paper's offload-relative GPU results are not speedups over an eligible fully resident quantized Apple runtime.

sources.title: EntroPack: Fast and Accurate Entropy-Coded Weight Compression at Arbitrary Bitrates
sources.authors: Hong Zhang, Zhongjie Duan, Yingda Chen
sources.location: Abstract; section 4.4 table 2 and accompanying discussion; appendix A.1
sources.support_paraphrase: Combines lattice quantization with entropy-coded independently decodable tiles and fused GPU reconstruction. It identifies online decode overhead as a reason to favor compute-heavy workloads. Its language-model timing separates prefill and autoregressive work; the latter assumes full draft acceptance for an eight-position verification workload and is slower than its BF16 reference.
sources.boundary: Do not convert its device timings or prefill observations into interactive latency. Independently decodable tiles alone are not a novel Olympus mechanism.

sources.title: LLM in a flash: Efficient Large Language Model Inference with Limited Memory
sources.authors: Keivan Alizadeh et al.
sources.support_paraphrase: Loads predicted needed FFN weights from flash, reuses recent neuron weights through a sliding cache, and bundles rows/columns for more efficient reads. It separates I/O, memory-management, and compute costs. Some evaluated models require activation changes and additional training to obtain sparsity.
sources.boundary: Predicts activation support, not numerical weights. Transfer volume, read granularity, cache size, model sparsity, and hardware are essential conditions. Dense GELU Olympus source does not inherit those conditions.

sources.title: PowerInfer: Fast Large Language Model Serving with a Consumer-grade GPU
sources.authors: Yixin Song, Zeyu Mi, Haotong Xie, Haibo Chen
sources.support_paraphrase: Exploits uneven neuron activation, keeping frequently used neurons on GPU and handling colder neurons on CPU, using activation predictors and sparse operations.
sources.boundary: CPU/GPU placement and sparse activation assumptions are specific; this is not a learned weight generator or a validated unified-memory Mac implementation.

sources.title: PowerInfer-2: Fast Large Language Model Inference on a Smartphone
sources.authors: Zhenliang Xue et al.
sources.support_paraphrase: Partitions execution into neuron clusters, uses heterogeneous compute units for different sparsity regimes, and coordinates storage I/O with computation and a segmented cache.
sources.boundary: The device-specific runtime integration is substantive. Merely implementing a lazy Python loader does not reproduce it.

sources.title: FlexGen: High-Throughput Generative Inference of Large Language Models with a Single GPU
sources.authors: Ying Sheng et al.
sources.support_paraphrase: Targets large-batch latency-insensitive inference using GPU, CPU, and disk capacity; optimizes placement/access and applies low-bit compression.
sources.boundary: Throughput under large batches and single-user response latency answer different questions.

sources.title: IMPACT: Importance-Aware Activation Space Reconstruction
sources.authors: Md Mokarram Chowdhury, Daniel Agyei Asante, Ernie Chang, Yang Li
sources.publication: arXiv 2507.03828, v4 dated 2026-04-20; author metadata says ACL 2026
sources.support_paraphrase: Formulates low-rank compression with activation structure and gradient-based importance, deriving reconstruction bases from an importance-weighted activation covariance matrix. It argues that weight-space error and uniform activation error do not adequately capture downstream sensitivity.
sources.boundary: This supports considering functional distortion; it does not prove every weight-reconstruction objective fails or establish Olympus gains.

sources.title: Enhancing Accuracy and Parameter-Efficiency of Neural Representations for Network Parameterization
sources.authors: Hongjun Choi, Jayaraman J. Thiagarajan, Ruben Glatt, Shusen Liu
sources.support_paraphrase: Distinguishes recovering original accuracy from improving parameter efficiency; reports circumstances where weight reconstruction alone suffices for recovery and proposes separating reconstruction from auxiliary distillation objectives for constrained parameterization.
sources.boundary: Conditional empirical findings caution against the opposite blanket claim that distillation is always required.

sources.title: Learning Mixed-Curvature Representations in Product Spaces
sources.authors: Albert Gu, Frederic Sala, Beliz Gunel, Christopher Re
sources.location: Primary indexed submission abstract; authors' repository README
sources.support_paraphrase: Embeds data in products of Euclidean, hyperbolic, and spherical spaces, considers the product signature and curvature, and provides implementation options selecting dimensions and numbers of component spaces.
sources.boundary: The final OpenReview page/PDF returned a verification wall. The indexed primary submission and authors' implementation support the mechanism, but no numerical result is used here.

sources.title: Neural Latent Geometry Search: Product Manifold Inference via Gromov-Hausdorff-Informed Bayesian Optimization
sources.authors: Haitz Sáez de Ocáriz Borde, Alvaro Arroyo, Ismael Morales, Ingmar Posner, Xiaowen Dong
sources.support_paraphrase: Searches products of constant-curvature latent spaces with a geometry-informed similarity notion and Bayesian optimization to limit costly candidate evaluations.
sources.boundary: Automatic latent-geometry search is prior art; this is not implemented by naming a geometry from input metadata.

sources.title: Adaptive Computation Time for Recurrent Neural Networks
sources.authors: Alex Graves
sources.support_paraphrase: Learns the amount of recurrent computation per input using a differentiable mechanism. Its abstract reports favorable synthetic-problem behavior but no large performance gains on the studied character-language-modeling task.
sources.boundary: An adaptive-compute mechanism and toy success need not generalize to language-model quality.

sources.title: Mixture-of-Depths: Dynamically allocating compute in transformer-based language models
sources.authors: David Raposo et al.
sources.support_paraphrase: Uses learned routing and a fixed cap on participating tokens per layer, giving predictable token-level computation while token identities change dynamically.
sources.boundary: Learned token routing is distinct from external reasoning-branch selection or weight reconstruction.

sources.title: Tree of Thoughts: Deliberate Problem Solving with Large Language Models
sources.authors: Shunyu Yao et al.
sources.support_paraphrase: Searches alternative intermediate reasoning steps with model evaluation, lookahead, and backtracking on selected tasks.
sources.boundary: Generated reasoning trajectories are not equivalent to differently prefixed prompt templates; all candidate-generation and scoring costs belong in the budget.

sources.title: Selecting Computations: Theory and Applications
sources.authors: Nicholas Hay, Stuart Russell, David Tolpin, Solomon Eyal Shimony
sources.support_paraphrase: Studies metalevel selection of computations according to expected improvement in the eventual decision, distinguishing this from cumulative reward maximization in conventional bandits.
sources.boundary: Provides a principled decision target. It does not make a product of hand-assigned factors an empirical value-of-information estimate. The proceedings reissue date is not the original research date.

sources.title: On Calibration of Modern Neural Networks
sources.authors: Chuan Guo, Geoff Pleiss, Yu Sun, Kilian Q. Weinberger
sources.support_paraphrase: Calibration concerns how predicted probabilities correspond to actual correctness frequency; the paper evaluates neural-network miscalibration and post-hoc correction methods.
sources.boundary: A single outcome checked against arbitrary confidence thresholds cannot establish population calibration. No post-hoc method automatically guarantees calibration after distribution shift.

not_used_as_evidence.title: BiSCo-LLM
not_used_as_evidence.reason: Search surfaced a relevant primary abstract, but canonical opening returned DisabledError. Not needed for the conclusion; do not promote derivative summaries into confirmed evidence.

not_used_as_evidence.title: Cross-Layer Subspace Coupling for LLM Compression: A Unifying Framework and Its Empirical Limits
not_used_as_evidence.reason: Primary preprint reports a useful negative reconstruction-versus-task-quality example, but only its abstract was reviewed. The core critique already follows from the explicit mathematical contract and closer sources.

not_used_as_evidence.title: A Middle Path for On-Premises LLM Deployment
not_used_as_evidence.reason: Inspected and excluded because the principal mechanism concerns model confidentiality, not the requested weight-reconstruction and selection mechanisms.

not_used_as_evidence.title: NWC repository at parda21/NWC; Unweight; secondary paper indexes
not_used_as_evidence.reason: Search leads only; not independently associated with the Ryu et al. paper or relied upon for technical claims.

scope_note: Main-derived source contracts and the separately inspected PR29 lazy-shard implementation are distinguished in the Markdown. Literature findings do not transfer results among these implementations.
